Standard API Framework: Message Broker System 1.2.0
  • application/json
  • EcoHub AG
  • support@myecohub.ch
  • ID: https://www.myecohub.ch

API to connect to the SAF Kafka cluster using the kafka native protocol.

Changes in Version 1.2.0

  • Added support for Generic Exchange events (ch.ecohub.saf.generic) on the IN topic
  • Added channel and operation to consume the generic OUT topic
  • Added dedicated Generic Exchange processName schema
  • Added BusinessDomainType
  • ProcessNameType: added new value for claimsExperience.nlpi
  • Added channel and operation to consume the claimsExperience.nlpi OUT topic
  • Added ClaimsExperienceNlpiErrorEventType on the IN topic and the claimsExperience.nlpi OUT topic
  • Aligned schema documentation with the actual implementation; this does not change the SAF Message Broker API behavior
    • Fix max.message.bytes of the IN topic to be 8388608 instead of 8338608
    • Optional CloudEvents attributes are no longer documented as explicitly nullable; if not set, they should be omitted
    • Normalized the processId format annotation to uuid
  • Added SAFIDSEventType (ch.ecohub.saf.ids) for Intelligent Data Structuring events
  • Root-level scalar projections for Kafka-level filtering and routing: confidenceScore, documentQuality, isValid, routingDecision, requiresHumanReview, reviewReason
  • documentQuality enum: excellent, high, medium, low, poor
  • idsEventDataType with fully typed component schemas for all IDS metadata groups: basicProcessingMetadataType, documentQualityMetricsType, detailedExtractionDataType, documentQualityAssessmentType, receiverRecommendationsType, validationResultsType, fieldExtractionAuditType and their supporting sub-types
  • detailedExtractionData, documentQualityAssessment, receiverRecommendations, and fieldExtractionAudit are optional (processing output, omitted when not produced)
  • Added channel and operation to consume the IDS OUT topic

Changes in Version 1.1.0

  • Improved documentation
  • increased max.message.bytes to 8388608 bytes (8MB) for all topics
  • ProcessNameType
    • renamed the enum values for proxy standards. These values were not yet supported by the platform and could not be used yet, therefore this change is treated as MINOR, not MAJOR.
    • added enum values for remaining legacy standards
  • SubProcessNameType
    • renamed the enum values for proxy standards. These values were not yet supported by the platform and could not be used yet, therefore this change is treated as MINOR, not MAJOR.
    • added enum values for remaining legacy standards
  • added operation to consume commission topic
  • added operation to consume invoice topic
  • added operation to consume contract topic
  • added operation to consume mandate topic
  • added operation to consume claimsExperience topic

changes in previous versions are available in the changelog file in GitHub

    Operation IDproduceSAFEvent

    Available only on servers:

    • ecohub-iat-saf-server
    • ecohub-prod-saf-server
    object
    topic
    eh.saf.in.v1
    partitions
    9
    replicas
    2
    object
    tuple<string, ...optional<any>>
    1 item:
    delete
    retention.ms
    604800000
    retention.bytes

    delete.retention.ms

    8388608

    Accepts one of the following messages:

    • #0SAF Event (Business Data or Acknowledge)produceSAFEvent

      Event which either contains business data or is used to transmit an acknowledge message.

      • application/json
      Message IDproduceSAFEvent
      object

      The main event type which can either be used to transmit business data according to a data standard or to send an acknowledge event.

      id
      required
      string
      non-empty

      Identifies the event. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event. If a duplicate event is re-sent (e.g. due to a network error) it MAY have the same id. Consumers MAY assume that Events with identical source and id are duplicates.

        Examples values:
      • "A234-1234-1234"
      source
      required
      string
      format: uri-referencenon-empty

      Uniquely identifies the producer of the event. Must be globally unique, including across environments.

        Examples values:
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/iat/ecohub-processes"
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/prod/ecohub-processes"
      specversion
      required
      string
      non-empty

      The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses. MUST be set to 1.0

        Examples values:
      • "1.0"
      type
      required
      string

      Reverse DNS entry defining the Standard process SAF data event type. Restricted to ch.ecohub.saf.data for Data events (member of EventType).

        Allowed values:
      • "ch.ecohub.saf.data"
      datacontenttype
      string
      non-empty

      Content type of the data value. Must adhere to RFC 2046 format.

        Examples values:
      • "text/xml"
      • "application/json"
      dataschema
      string
      format: urinon-empty

      Identifies the schema that data adheres to. Must point to the respective raw schema in the EcoHub GitHub schema repository (https://github.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards).

        Examples values:
      • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiRequestDataType.json"
      • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiDataType.json"
      subject
      string
      non-empty

      Describes the subject of the event to provide additional context about the event.

        Examples values:
      • "Billing november 2024"
      • "MF offer company A"
      time
      string
      format: date-timenon-empty

      Timestamp of when the occurrence happened. Must adhere to RFC 3339.

        Examples values:
      • "2018-04-05T17:31:03.526Z"
      licenceKey
      required
      string
      [ 3 .. 200 ] characters

      The license key for the requesting SC application.

      required
      object

      Identifies the software that was used to produce the event

      name
      required
      string
      [ 3 .. 100 ] characters

      Name of the application

      version
      required
      string
      [ 3 .. 30 ] characters

      Used version of the application

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      required
      object
      category
      required
      string

      The category of the organisation

        Allowed values:
      • "broker"
      • "insurer"
      • "serviceprovider"
      id
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The IDP number of the member's techUser. The IDP number of the eventReceiver can be determined through the /saf-receivers endpoint of the General API.

        Examples values:
      • "IDP1239856"
      onBehalfBy
      string
      must match: ^IDP(\d{7})$

      The IDP number of the software provider's techUser if the event is send on behalf.

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      required
      object
      category
      required
      string

      The category of the organisation

        Allowed values:
      • "broker"
      • "insurer"
      • "serviceprovider"
      id

      >= 3 characters

      The IDP number of the member's techUser. The IDP number of the eventReceiver can be determined through the /saf-receivers endpoint of the General API.

        Examples values:

      onBehalfBy
      string
      must match: ^IDP(\d{7})$

      The IDP number of the software provider's techUser if the event is send on behalf.

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      object

      The data transmitted with the event and relevant attributes for signing and encryption.

      payload
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original payload. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

      payloadSignature
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted payload. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

      array<object>
      non-empty
      object
      description
      string

      Description of the purpose of the link

      href
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      the- encrypted URL that should be called, to receive additional encrypted unstructured data, such as pdf, pictures, etc.

      rel
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The IG B2B Standard the links belongs to.

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      encryptionKey
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted data. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

      publicKeyVersion
      required
      string

      The version of the receiver's public key that was used to encrypt the encryptionKey.

      signatureKeyVersion
      required
      string

      The version of your signature key, that was used to sign the payload.

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      processGroupId
      string
      format: uuid

      UUID, that is used to associate multiple processes. The exact usage is specified in each data standard.

      processId
      required
      string
      format: uuid

      UUID, that won't change during the offer processes. The UUID is set by the party, that starts the process.

      processName
      required
      string

      Identifier of the core process

        Allowed values:
      • "offer.nlpi"
      • "invoice"
      • "commission"
      • "contract"
      • "mandate"
      • "claimsExperience"
      • "claimsExperience.nlpi"
      processVersion
      required
      string
      must match: ^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?(?:\+([0-9a-zA-Z-]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*))?$

      Version of the used core process

      processStatus
      required
      string

      Defines status of the overall process.

        Allowed values:
      • "active"
      • "closed"
      subProcessName
      required
      string

      Identifier for the current subprocess / process step within the core process.

        Allowed values:
      • "request"
      • "offer"
      • "feedback"
      • "conclusionDecision"
      • "billing"
      • "reminder"
      • "contract"
      • "commission"
      • "submission"
      • "cancellation"
      • "claimsExperience"
      subProcessStatus
      required
      string
        Allowed values:
      • "Created"
      • "Received"
      • "InProgress"
      • "Responded"
      • "Updated"
      • "Error"
      • "Inquiry"
      • "Inquiry_Answer"
      • "Closed"

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

      object
      object

      Format of the kafka message key

      processId
      required
      string
      format: uuid

      UUID, that won't change during the offer processes. The UUID is set by the party, that starts the process.

      Additional properties are NOT allowed.

    • #2SAF Intelligent Data Structuring (IDS) EventproduceSAFIDSEvent

      Intelligent Data Structuring (IDS) event used to send unstructured business information (pdf, images, etc.) to the intelligent data structuring service. The IDS will return structured data based on the Broker and Insurer Standard definitions.

      • application/json
      Message IDproduceSAFIDSEvent
      object

      IDS event type for Intelligent Data Structuring events (ch.ecohub.saf.ids). Extends the base SAF event with root-level scalar projections for Kafka-level routing and quality gating: confidenceScore, documentQuality, isValid, routingDecision, requiresHumanReview, and reviewReason.

      id
      required
      string
      non-empty

      Identifies the event. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event. If a duplicate event is re-sent (e.g. due to a network error) it MAY have the same id. Consumers MAY assume that Events with identical source and id are duplicates.

        Examples values:
      • "A234-1234-1234"
      source
      required
      string
      format: uri-referencenon-empty

      Uniquely identifies the producer of the event. Must be globally unique, including across environments.

        Examples values:
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/iat/ecohub-processes"
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/prod/ecohub-processes"
      specversion
      required
      string
      non-empty

      The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses. MUST be set to 1.0

        Examples values:
      • "1.0"
      type
      required
      string

      CloudEvents event type. Restricted to ch.ecohub.saf.ids for IDS events (member of EventType).

        Allowed values:
      • "ch.ecohub.saf.ids"
      datacontenttype
      string
      non-empty

      Content type of the data value. Must adhere to RFC 2046 format.

        Examples values:
      • "text/xml"
      • "application/json"
      dataschema
      string
      format: urinon-empty

      Identifies the schema that data adheres to. Must point to the respective raw schema in the EcoHub GitHub schema repository (https://github.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards).

      subject
      string
      non-empty

      time

      confidenceScore
      number
      format: double[ 0 .. 1 ]

      Overall confidence score indicating aggregate confidence in extraction results.

      Range: 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (high confidence)

      Calculation: Derived from field-level confidence scores and document quality metrics:

      • Accounts for OCR quality, document clarity, and field extraction confidence
      • Provides single metric for receivers to assess extraction reliability
      • Used by validation engine and receiver recommendations

      Purpose:

      • Quick assessment of overall extraction quality
      • Input for routing decisions (auto-approve vs. review vs. verify)
      • Compliance and audit trail documentation

      Mapping to SAFIDSEventType: Maps to confidenceScore property in Kafka event

      object

      The message transmitted with the event and relevant attributes for signing and encryption.

      encryptionKey
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

      messageSignature
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

      message
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

      publicKeyVersion
      required
      string

      The version of the receiver's public key that was used to encrypt the encryptionKey.

      signatureKeyVersion
      required
      string

      The version of your signature key, that was used to sign the message.

      encryptionKey
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

      messageSignature
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

      message
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

    Accepts one of the following messages:

    • #0SAF Event (Business Data or Acknowledge)consumeSAFEvent

      Event which either contains business data or is used to transmit an acknowledge message.

      • application/json
      Message IDconsumeSAFEvent
      object

      The main event type which can either be used to transmit business data according to a data standard or to send an acknowledge event.

      id
      required
      string
      non-empty

      Identifies the event. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event. If a duplicate event is re-sent (e.g. due to a network error) it MAY have the same id. Consumers MAY assume that Events with identical source and id are duplicates.

        Examples values:
      • "A234-1234-1234"
      source
      required
      string
      format: uri-referencenon-empty

      Uniquely identifies the producer of the event. Must be globally unique, including across environments.

        Examples values:
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/iat/ecohub-processes"
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/prod/ecohub-processes"
      specversion
      required
      string
      non-empty

      The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses. MUST be set to 1.0

        Examples values:
      • "1.0"
      type
      required
      string

      Reverse DNS entry defining the Standard process SAF data event type. Restricted to ch.ecohub.saf.data for Data events (member of EventType).

        Allowed values:
      • "ch.ecohub.saf.data"
      datacontenttype
      string
      non-empty

      Content type of the data value. Must adhere to RFC 2046 format.

        Examples values:
      • "text/xml"
      • "application/json"
      dataschema
      string
      format: urinon-empty

      Identifies the schema that data adheres to. Must point to the respective raw schema in the EcoHub GitHub schema repository (https://github.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards).

        Examples values:
      • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiRequestDataType.json"
      • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiDataType.json"
      subject
      string
      non-empty

      Describes the subject of the event to provide additional context about the event.

        Examples values:
      • "Billing november 2024"
      • "MF offer company A"
      time
      string
      format: date-timenon-empty

      Timestamp of when the occurrence happened. Must adhere to RFC 3339.

        Examples values:
      • "2018-04-05T17:31:03.526Z"

      required
      string
      [ 3 .. 200 ] characters

      payload
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original payload. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

      payloadSignature
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted payload. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

      The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

      messageSignature
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

      message
      required
      string
      >= 3 characters

      The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

      confidenceScore
      number
      format: double[ 0 .. 1 ]

      Overall confidence score indicating aggregate confidence in extraction results.

      Range: 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (high confidence)

      Calculation: Derived from field-level confidence scores and document quality metrics:

      • Accounts for OCR quality, document clarity, and field extraction confidence
      • Provides single metric for receivers to assess extraction reliability
      • Used by validation engine and receiver recommendations

      Purpose:

      • Quick assessment of overall extraction quality
      • Input for routing decisions (auto-approve vs. review vs. verify)
      • Compliance and audit trail documentation

      Mapping to SAFIDSEventType: Maps to confidenceScore property in Kafka event

      Events that are used to send technical saf errors, i.e. errors that don't stem from the transmitted business data.

      • application/json
      Message IDsafErrorEvent
      object

      SAF error event, i.e. an event for errors which are unrelated to the event payload.

      id
      required
      string
      non-empty

      Identifies the event. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event. If a duplicate event is re-sent (e.g. due to a network error) it MAY have the same id. Consumers MAY assume that Events with identical source and id are duplicates.

        Examples values:
      • "A234-1234-1234"
      source
      required
      string
      format: uri-referencenon-empty

      Uniquely identifies the producer of the event. Must be globally unique, including across environments.

        Examples values:
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/iat/ecohub-processes"
      • "http://www.myecohub.ch/prod/ecohub-processes"

      non-empty

    Overall confidence score indicating aggregate confidence in extraction results.

    Range: 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (high confidence)

    Calculation: Derived from field-level confidence scores and document quality metrics:

    • Accounts for OCR quality, document clarity, and field extraction confidence
    • Provides single metric for receivers to assess extraction reliability
    • Used by validation engine and receiver recommendations

    Purpose:

    • Quick assessment of overall extraction quality
    • Input for routing decisions (auto-approve vs. review vs. verify)
    • Compliance and audit trail documentation

  • #4SAF Inquiry EventsafInquiryEvent

    Events that are used to send a general purpose message

    • application/json
    Message IDsafInquiryEvent
    object

    SAF inquiry event, i.e. an event containing a generic message.

    id
    required
    string
    non-empty

    Identifies the event. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event. If a duplicate event is re-sent (e.g. due to a network error) it MAY have the same id. Consumers MAY assume that Events with identical source and id are duplicates.

      Examples values:
    • "A234-1234-1234"
    source
    required
    string
    format: uri-referencenon-empty

    Uniquely identifies the producer of the event. Must be globally unique, including across environments.

      Examples values:
    • "http://www.myecohub.ch/iat/ecohub-processes"
    • "http://www.myecohub.ch/prod/ecohub-processes"
    specversion

    string
    non-empty

    The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses. MUST be set to 1.0

      Examples values:
    • "1.0"
    datacontenttype
    string
    non-empty

    Content type of the data value. Must adhere to RFC 2046 format.

      Examples values:
    • "text/xml"
    • "application/json"
    dataschema
    string
    format: urinon-empty

    Identifies the schema that data adheres to. Must point to the respective raw schema in the EcoHub GitHub schema repository (https://github.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards).

      Examples values:
    • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiRequestDataType.json"
    • "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EcoHub-AG/Standards/refs/tags/Offer_NLPI_v0.3.0/schemas/Offer-NLPI/v0.3.0/offer-nlpi-root/OfferNlpiDataType.json"
    subject

    non-empty

      Examples values:

    • "MF offer company A"
    time
    string
    format: date-timenon-empty

    object

    The message transmitted with the event and relevant attributes for signing and encryption.

    encryptionKey
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

    messageSignature
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

    message
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

    publicKeyVersion
    required
    string

    The version of the receiver's public key that was used to encrypt the encryptionKey.

    signatureKeyVersion
    required
    string

    The version of your signature key, that was used to sign the message.

    object

    The data transmitted with the event and relevant attributes for signing and encryption.

    payload
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original payload. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

    payloadSignature
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted payload. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key.     encryptionKey
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

    messageSignature
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

    message
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

    publicKeyVersion
    required
    string

    The version of the receiver's public key that was used to encrypt the encryptionKey.

    signatureKeyVersion
    required

  • object

    The message transmitted with the event and relevant attributes for signing and encryption.

    encryptionKey
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The encrypted AES key, which was used to symmetrically encrypt the transmitted message. The key must be encrypted with the public key of the eventReceiver using RSA with OAEP padding with a SHA256 hash.

    messageSignature
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    A digital signature used to verify the origin of the encrypted message. The signature is created by signing the content of the payload attribute using the elliptic curve algorithm secp384r1 with a SHA-384 hash, and your active signature key. The resulting signature must be ASN.1 encoded and transmitted in Base64.

    message
    required
    string
    >= 3 characters

    The base64 representation of the first g-zipped and then encrypted original message. For encryption, the AES-GCM algorithm with a 256-bit key, a 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and a 128-bit authentication tag must be used.

    publicKeyVersion
    required
    string

    The version of the receiver's public key that was used to encrypt the encryptionKey.

    signatureKeyVersion
    required
    string

    The version of your signature key, that was used to sign the message.

    Additional properties are NOT allowed.

  • confidenceScoreType
    number
    format: double[ 0 .. 1 ]

    Overall confidence score indicating aggregate confidence in extraction results.

    Range: 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (high confidence)

    Calculation: Derived from field-level confidence scores and document quality metrics:

    • Accounts for OCR quality, document clarity, and field extraction confidence
    • Provides single metric for receivers to assess extraction reliability
    • Used by validation engine and receiver recommendations

    Purpose:

    • Quick assessment of overall extraction quality
    • Input for routing decisions (auto-approve vs. review vs. verify)
    • Compliance and audit trail documentation

    Mapping to SAFIDSEventType: Maps to confidenceScore property in Kafka event
